title: Service Availability < 100% on frontend-web during traffic spike
description: Synthetic availability checks report frontend-web below 100% availability during a flash-sale traffic spike. Request rate exceeds what the current replica count can absorb: the HPA scales too slowly, request queues saturate, p99 latency climbs, and readiness probes start failing under load.
raw_logs: 2026-08-31T09:05:10.000Z WARN  [frontend-web] request rate 4.8x above 7-day baseline (flash sale campaign opened)
2026-08-31T09:06:02.300Z INFO  [kube-controller] HPA frontend-web: target CPU 65%, current 92% - scaling 6 -> 8 replicas (delayed 4m by stabilization window)
2026-08-31T09:07:44.100Z WARN  [frontend-web] upstream connect queue depth 240 exceeds soft limit 200; shedding least-recent requests
2026-08-31T09:08:21.700Z ERROR [frontend-web] request latency SLO breach: p99=3950ms (objective 800ms)
2026-08-31T09:09:05.900Z WARN  [kubelet] readiness probe "http-get /healthz" failing for pod frontend-web-7d9c4-2: context deadline exceeded (2000ms)
2026-08-31T09:09:48.400Z ERROR [frontend-web] availability check /storefront returned 503 after 5s: no ready endpoints in pool (4 of 10 pods not ready)
2026-08-31T09:10:12.500Z ERROR [lb-frontend] availability synthetic check failed: storefront availability 91.2% (objective 100%)
2026-08-31T09:11:30.800Z WARN  [frontend-web] connection pool to session-store saturating: active=98 idle=2 waiting=51

raw_events.description: Flash-sale campaign opened; request rate 4.8x baseline within 90 seconds
HPA stabilization window raised to 300s and target CPU lowered to 65% in previous tuning change
